title: Retrofit filelock-based mutex into PEAD/PEAD-GAP execution scripts + dream-cycle build phase
rationale: task-registry.md documents at least 4 distinct duplicate-execution races this year with real or destructive side effects: PEAD-GAP open-pass 4 invocations in 65 seconds on 2026-07-31 (only avoided a double order because of an incidental 'already in positions' check, not a designed guard), dream-cycle build-phase double wiki-append on 2026-08-01, and two git add/commit sweep incidents on 2026-08-03. Tonight's wiki research (wiki/trading/paper-trading/idempotency-concurrency-control.md) identified filelock (PyPI, 975 GitHub stars, MIT, actively maintained, v3.32.3 as of 2026-08-13) as a right-sized fix: single-container Python scripts writing local JSON/log files don't need Redis/Postgres distributed locking, just a local advisory FileLock around each script's critical section, with a short timeout that treats lock contention as 'another instance already running this slot, exit quietly' rather than crashing.
content:
Proposed change (applies the same pattern to 5 files — flagging for Kevin review rather than auto-applying since these are live order-submission and build-phase scripts):

1. pead_gap_open.py, pead_open.py, pead_exits.py, pead_gap_exits.py: wrap the entire run body in `from filelock import FileLock, Timeout; lock = FileLock(SCRIPT_DIR / '.<name>.lock', timeout=5)` and run the existing logic inside `with lock:`; on `Timeout`, log 'lock held by another process, skipping this run' and exit 0 rather than proceeding. Requires `pip install filelock` in venv/ first (not done yet — verify PyPI existence already done, install requires either an interactive session or explicit Kevin approval per the off-hours install policy).
2. Dream-cycle build phase (whatever script/task runner executes staged-proposal application): wrap the apply-loop in the same FileLock pattern, combined with the existing grep-c idempotency check already documented in task-registry.md, so a compaction-resumed session can't re-enter the append step mid-run.

Full design rationale and code example: wiki/trading/paper-trading/idempotency-concurrency-control.md (Pattern 1).
